run_split_cifar100_into_tasks: run the script to split CIFAR-100 data into N incremental learning tasks and save to output file
run_load_and_normalize_cifar100: run the script to load raw CIFAR-100 tensors and normalize pixel values to 0-1 range
run_partition_classes_by_task: run the script to partition CIFAR-100 classes into equal groups for continual learning tasks
run_save_task_datasets: run the script to save training and test task datasets as a PyTorch checkpoint file
run_set_random_seed: run the script with a custom random seed for reproducible task splitting of CIFAR-100
